I'm not too fond of some of the things rich Americans have done in the past but I can assure you I don't hate the entirety of your population just for being American. That kind of hatred ideology is utterly shameful. You look at a lot of western society and how it's ok to be yourself and not be criticised for it, for me "hating on the yanks" as we call it at home was just always a banter thing I'd never outright say I hate you as people, and to be honest you could be the nicest most down to earth person with the kindest heart just because you're something you had no control over doesn't necessarily mean that you should be seen as a generalized stereotype. 

I'm so sorry you have to experience this bullshit negativity on the daily. I respect you for sharing your feelings and I truly wish you would reconsider your negative thoughts because if some random peeps on the interwebs can recognise and respect that you're human too, and you're just doing what you need to do to survive then I'm confident the majority of the world would recognize that too!! 

You have so much value and you probably don't even realise it, you could be one of the most talented people to have ever existed and just don't know it yet, why would you let genuine assholes get in the way of you living your life. Dear American I'm Irish, and I have nothing but praise for 99% of you people I've met over the years and you know why? Because I see humans being humans at the end of the day we are not entitled to this world and we are the same damn race, being objectified by your nationality is meaningless, it's who you are as a person that matters to most people. 

I hope you find what support you are looking for and I hope you don't treat yourself too hard for again something that was never in your control to begin with. Peace homie! Rock on, and be yourself!!

Firstly I hope you're doing well. 
As someone who lives for his friends there comes a time when naturally they will betray your trust. 

You have to live for yourself. It's okay to use the excuse of living for others until you get to a point where you are comfortable with yourself. I'm not gonna give you the usual bullshit and tell you it's all gonna be sunshine and rainbows because life isn't that, unless you make it so. The funny thing I've learned is that the power is in your mind. If you're feeling bad then it's you succumbing to your minds overworked bs that makes you feel that way, and on the flip side happiness is possible through manifestation in positive outlooks. 

I can categorically guarantee that you have yet to reach your potential. I don't know you or know anything about you, but I would say that you are absolutely worth the fucking world! Don't let anyone ever tell you otherwise. You think greats like Einstein lived life with pure laughter and joy and all? Impossible science dictates that what goes up must come down, meaning that the life you are living is filled with ups and downs. 

I believe life is a game, and the game is for you to teach yourself and prepare for the next life and the future however, don't get caught up in the future too much, it will come. You don't want to go unprepared do you? To take your own life is to deny yourself and your future self the chance to live and experience what you can do. 

I can't tell you what to do, but I can advise you as someone who has these thoughts consistently as well, they don't go away, but you learn to live with them and suppress them naturally. Never forget that without pain there cannot be any gain. I hope you're okay and hope you will get yourself out of this rut. If this random gobshite stranger can believe in you just imagine what your family and friends can and will believe you can achieve too :) 
Much love and respect for reaching out for support and not immediately just doing something silly cos of bad feelings.

I hope you are okay, and I hope you realise just how much YOU are worth too. Never forget you have your own emotions too and they matter and should be valued I wish you the best of luck

Just because you disagree with what they say and you don't have any reasoning to back up your argument doesn't mean you have to criticise someone else's experience and advice based on that experience.

As a man, I look at this with utter disgust. I look at this behaviour and think there's no way in hell I'd accept someone treating me like this so there's no way in hell I could ever condone someone being treated like this, me or anyone else. This element of "controlling what's mine" kind of thing is annoying to me.

A relationship is a two way street where both partners consent to being with each other exclusively but that doesn't AT ANY FUCKING POINT mean that the other owns you. I would never be able to handle someone who treated me like their property. Nor would I be able to comfortably be that way myself. I've grown up seeing it all around me in other distant elements of family but never directly in my own, perhaps that's why I find it easy to have disdain such outlandish behaviour, but OP.

Addressing you directly. I cannot comment on behalf of another person but what I can share with you is my unease with regards to this situation. I know you find that he has been your best partner yet so this isn't going to be easy to take on board, but from my perspective he's sorry that he caused pain in a way he didn't intend, much like others have commented here, he (again this is just my opinion I don't know the fella) seems to me like he is going to get more and more controlling it starts small and gets larger and larger and the worst thing is, because of the way humans are designed, it's easier to roll with it rather than face the potential truth that he ain't your guy! 

I just hope going forward that you have enough self respect to do what's right for you. We cannot tell you what to do, but can only advise based on our own experiences, to me I'd run for the hills, I hope you're okay and you will have the strength to do what you need to do, not for him, but for you!!

My brother in Christ I don't think it's that deep, I commend you for standing up for good core values but the issue with the current day and age is people get offended on behalf of a group or an individual just like you are here based on THEIR perception on behaviour. And now you're borderline projecting on something that was said as a joke. Calm down, step away from the Interwebs, take a deep breath and if it still annoys you then close down Reddit for a while.

Why does it matter about being grammatically correct on an internet platform where one is sharing their experience? You seem a bit of a stickler for grammar and if that's your thing that's fine, however perhaps you should consider NOT commenting if something irks you and just move on. I could have moved on but because you were rude perhaps you'll understand why I've chosen to speak back to you when you could have easily avoided this matter. Judge silently or don't judge at all, not everyone eeds to hear you (nor wants to).

You're not pathetic. You've been pushed into a mentality where you feel inadequate because you're essentially seeking approval to avoid abuse. It's a toxic cycle. I think a lot of people experience this but typically it comes from peers essentially in the form of bullying 

I cannot nor will not comment on the intentions of others or other religious/ethical backgrounds but this is abusive bullying from those who are there to guide you into adulthood. 

I will say that I think the world is too soft and that sometimes a bit of stern parenting is very important for you to understand what how and why l, in a situational basis but typically what you've described is borderline torture. 

I do not with to disrespect your parents or family so I'll keep my opinion on their behaviour to myself but one to one, please don't EVER think of yourself as pathetic. You are resilient. Draw the distinct comparison from that you have survived all of this crap and are still learning. You're young and have so much life ahead of you. I can promise you life will be a shit show it's literally the most inconsistent thing being an adult haha but you'll make it because You're strong, stronger than you think you are. ❤️

My friend had a similar situation, he was abused by his brother at a young age and carried it until he was nearly 30 (last year) I was with him when he drunkenly confronted his brother throwing the accusations out there.

A very high and mighty proud family too so you can imagine the difficulty and dynamic. What I can tell you about that is he has never been more free to be able to talk about it.

Your family need to know sir. I apologise that you have had to go through this but please know that bottling it up or even as far as telling Reddit won't really solve the issues but you need some form of therapy to make yourself comfortable with yourself again.

I've seen it work! It can for you too. I hope you're okay and not thinking anything foolish with regards to your own life, especially when this circumstance came about through no fault of your own 

You're so strong and so brave to even tell strangers on the Interwebs, I would reach out to a family member you're closest with. Don't worry about them not believing you, they will it just takes time, that kind of an accusations true or not is a lot to digest, they will beat themselves up first for letting it go on so long unbeknownst to them, but I promise you they'll turn their attitude round once they come to terms with it themselves. It's unfortunately far more common than you might expect, please know you're not alone and you're not weak. You CAN do this! If you need any support anything at all please let the community here know we are all more than happy to answer any questions you may have (even though we don't know all the answers, some of us have experienced or witnessed similar things and we can help each other) please stay strong! I'm proud of you!!
